exposure: spinal anaesthesia with 1% Chloroprocaine and dexmedetomidine
outcome: duration of motor and sensory block
total dose of analgesia in 12 hours
cohort: 60 women undergoing elective lower segment caesarean section
finding: Spinal anaesthesia with 1% Chloroprocaine and dexmedetomidine provided faster onset of sensory block, longer duration of motor and sensory block, and reduced analgesic requirements compared to spinal anaesthesia with 1% Chloroprocaine alone.
